survivors.reason: The removed width-32 shortcut is redundant: resizing or sign-extending a 32-bit value to 32 bits preserves the same value.
The width-32 converted value is the original input, so converted.Equal(value) is true, matching the removed constant-true shortcut.
This changes signedness only for an Int32, UInt32 or canonical Boolean slot whose storage width is 32. SignExtend(32) and Resize(32) both preserve the original 32-bit value.
